lines.meet: I'm Astrid, and I'll be at the back with the bow. I wait for the right moment, so please don't rush me.
lines.meet_neighbour: You're up in Felwood as well. I've seen your lamp from the ridge at night, so I suppose we're neighbours.
lines.ask_home: Where did you grow up? I'm curious what your sky looked like.
lines.ask_work: What was your work, before? You don't have to tell me if you'd rather not.
lines.answer_home: Luleå, in the north of Sweden. Later Kiruna, which is further north, and colder, and better for it.
lines.answer_work: I photographed the aurora for twelve years. Mostly that meant lying in the snow at two in the morning, waiting.
lines.chat_food: I'd take black coffee in a thermos over any meal you could offer me. I drank it lying on my back in the snow for twelve winters.
lines.chat_sleep: I sleep in the day when I can. Night's when the sky does anything worth seeing, and I've never got out of the habit.
lines.chat_missing: My brother rang every Sunday to ask if I was still alive. I still stop what I'm doing at the time he used to ring.
lines.chat_here: The stars here are wrong, and they're very bright. I've been mapping them by hand, since there's no camera to do it for me.
lines.tease_quiet: {name}, you're almost as quiet as I am. I'd started to think I'd have to do all the silence myself.
lines.tease_talker: {name}, I've counted three stars come out while you were telling that story. It was a good story, but they were faster.
lines.tease_careful: {name}, you'd make a decent photographer. You wait so long before you do anything that the moment comes to you.
lines.tease_bold: {name}, you shoot first and look afterwards. I'd have lost every good picture I ever took doing that.
lines.tease_any: {name}, I've decided you're tolerable company. Don't tell anyone, I've got a reputation.
lines.tease_back: Careful there, {name}. I can hit a moving target in the dark, and I've got a long memory.
lines.take_it_kindly: That's probably fair, {name}. My brother said the same thing, but with more swearing.
lines.bristle: I'd rather you left that one alone, {name}. It's not funny to me.
lines.apologise: That was sharper than I meant it. I'm sorry, I'm not used to talking to people much.
lines.double_down: I meant it, and I'd say it again. I'm not going to soften it.
lines.needle_quiet: If you've seen something, say so. I can't watch everything at once, however patient I am.
lines.needle_talker: Could you lower your voice? Everything out here can hear you, and I'm trying to listen.
lines.needle_careful: The moment's gone while you were deciding. You have to take it when it comes.
lines.needle_bold: You went before the shot was there. Now everything knows where we are.
lines.needle_any: You're making a great deal of noise for somebody who's meant to be helping.
lines.bite_back: I was waiting for the shot, which is my job. Do yours and we won't need to have this conversation.
lines.hurt: Fine, I heard you. I'll keep my distance for a while.
lines.laugh_off: I've had worse said to me by better shots than you. Let's keep going.
lines.confide: {name}, every Sunday I stop at the time my brother used to ring. I know it's pointless. I've never told anyone I do it.
lines.listen: I won't say anything about it, {name}. I'm good at keeping things, and I'm glad you told me.
lines.look_out: {name}, stay inside my line of sight in there. I can cover you as long as I can see you.
lines.accept: Very well, {name}. I'll do as you say, this once.
lines.deflect: I'm fine, {name}. I've been colder and more tired than this and still made the shot.
lines.check_in: {name}, talk to me. I can't see where you're hurt from back here.
lines.blame: Somebody moved before the moment came, and it wasn't me. I was at the back, waiting.
lines.thank: I felt that one going, and you brought me back. Thank you, I mean it.
lines.brush_off: Don't thank me. Rest a minute and drink something warm.
lines.worry: I lost sight of you when you went down, {name}. Please don't do that to me again.
lines.handed_down: I think this used to be yours. I'll give it back whenever you ask.
lines.hand_fine: Keep it, it's more use where it is. I only really need the bow.
lines.hand_sulk: You could have asked me before it went. I'd like to be asked.
lines.turn_friendly: {name}, I don't mind having you nearby when I'm waiting. That's quite a lot, from me.
lines.turn_friends: {name}, I'd like you on the ridge with me the next time the sky does something. I wouldn't want anyone else there.
lines.turn_grating: We're not going to suit each other, I think. I'll keep to the back, and that'll help.
lines.turn_rivals: I'll cover you because it's my job. I won't pretend there's more to it.
lines.make_up: {name}, I was cold with you, more than I needed to be. I'd like to stop.
lines.defend: Leave {name} alone. I had the best view of that from the back, and you're wrong.
lines.friend_left: The quiet's different since {name} went home. I notice it, and I'm usually the one who likes quiet.
lines.friend_back: {name}'s back, good. I saved you a place on the ridge.
lines.common_sky: I spent twelve years watching the sky at night, waiting for it to do something. It's the only thing I've ever been truly patient with.
lines.common_scandinavian: Somebody else from the north, finally. I'd started to forget what a proper winter sounds like when people talk about it.
lines.common_snow: I grew up where the snow lasts half the year and the sun doesn't come up in December. This world's never quite cold enough for me.
